plan.focus_en: 了 for things that happened, and talking about scores with 比 (三比一).

items.title_en: Read and read aloud: 在家看球
Guided mission: bargaining at a market stall

translations: This evening my friend and I watched the football at home. We both like Manchester United.
My friend brought some food and drinks. We sat and watched together.
At eight, Man United scored a goal! We both jumped to our feet.
In the end it was three–one. We were all smiling. I really love Man United!
My friend said: “Next time let’s go and watch it together!”

glossary.english: ball; a game of football (看球: watch the football)

translations: This month Mum and I went to Shanghai for fun.
We left very early. We were in the car for four hours.
Shanghai is big, and there are lots of people too. We walked a long way.
We found a little place to eat. Mum really liked the food here.
In the end we took the car home. We both really liked Shanghai!

missions.title: Bargaining at a market stall
missions.goal: Look at something, ask the price, bargain it down and buy it.

steps.partner_en: Hi, what would you like to buy?
steps.prompt_en: Say you'd like to have a look at this one.
answers_en: I'd like to look at this one.
Let me have a look at this one.

steps.prompt_en: Say it's too expensive and offer 100.

steps.partner_zh: 一百二十块吧，不能再少了。
steps.partner_en: 120 then, I can't go any lower.
steps.prompt_en: Say OK, you'll take it, thanks.

missions.title: Football plans with a friend
missions.goal: Tell your friend you're watching the match tonight, invite them over and make a plan for tomorrow.

steps.partner_en: Hey, what are you doing tonight?
steps.prompt_en: Say you're watching the football at home.
answers_en: I'm watching the football at home.
I'm going to watch the football at home.

steps.partner_zh: 我也想看！我能去你家吗？
steps.partner_en: I want to watch it too! Can I come to yours?
steps.prompt_en: Say of course, come at seven.

steps.partner_en: Great! Do you want me to bring anything?
steps.prompt_en: Ask them to bring some drinks.

steps.partner_zh: 没问题。明天下午我们去踢球吧？
steps.partner_en: No problem. Shall we go and play football tomorrow afternoon?
